title: Raluca - Second Meeting

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: I wasn't sure I'd see you again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I wasn't sure I'd see you again.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Glad that you have?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Glad that you have?

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: I'm still here, aren't I?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm still here, aren't I?

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: Sure, we can call it that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure, we can call it that.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: It's fine, I just wish people didn't notice it anymore.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's fine, I just wish people didn't notice it anymore.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: Luxury like that is not within my Lim-range.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Luxury like that is not within my Lim-range.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: No you're fine, it can be a bit of an adjustment for people.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No you're fine, it can be a bit of an adjustment for people.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: Normally? I don't remember much from my childhood but I can tell you that nothing that happens in the Spire is normal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Normally? I don't remember much from my childhood but I can tell you that nothing that happens in the Spire is normal.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: Bar the occasional case of Mask-Rash and the food, I think the world makes more sense from down here. Plus, I get to meet interesting people, like you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Bar the occasional case of Mask-Rash and the food, I think the world makes more sense from down here. Plus, I get to meet interesting people, like you.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: Ever heard of Pov-Play? It's where rich people go to group-events and pretend to be poor for a few days. Very popular in certain circles.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ever heard of Pov-Play? It's where rich people go to group-events and pretend to be poor for a few days. Very popular in certain circles.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: But we'd never have met.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But we'd never have met.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: That's just the tip of the Spire. It's a big place.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's just the tip of the Spire. It's a big place.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: I think we have very different tastes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think we have very different tastes.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: Well, that is a real shame.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, that is a real shame.

nodes.speaker: Raluca
nodes.text: Funny and good-looking, a rare cocktail.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Funny and good-looking, a rare cocktail.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's important to network.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's important to network.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How's life behind the mask?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How's life behind the mask?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm sorry I shouldn't have mentioned it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sorry I shouldn't have mentioned it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm sorry I shouldn't have mentioned it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm sorry I shouldn't have mentioned it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe try and use a smaller mask?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe try and use a smaller mask?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe try and use a smaller mask?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe try and use a smaller mask?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Would you ever go back to the Spire to live more normally?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Would you ever go back to the Spire to live more normally?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Would you ever go back to the Spire to live more normally?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Would you ever go back to the Spire to live more normally?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're more comfortable down here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're more comfortable down here?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: For example?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: For example?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Has to be better than this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Has to be better than this.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Has to be better than this.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Has to be better than this.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's gross.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's gross.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm glad I've made it all worthwhile.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm glad I've made it all worthwhile.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm glad I've made it all worthwhile.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm glad I've made it all worthwhile.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think I'd have chosen the Spire.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think I'd have chosen the Spire.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think I'd have chosen the Spire.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think I'd have chosen the Spire.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Kind of sounds fun!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Kind of sounds fun!
